task.title: To select table formatting when no data is present

step.cmd: Open Microsoft Word and launch the add-in.
Log in to X-Author for Contracts Advanced for Conga CLM (Contracts for Salesforce) and open the template.
In the Templates pane, go to Work> Fields. This displays the Repeat Table (object name) and the fields in the repeat table.
Select the Repeat Table and click the Settings button next to Repeat Table.
In the Table Attributes section, click Format. This displays a drop-down menu. Select one of the following options based on your requirement.

ol.li: To show table captions and one empty row, select Show captions and one empty row.
To show captions only and no rows, select Show captions only.
To remove the entire table from the generated document, select Remove whole table.
